package repository

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
)

// OutboxClaim controls a bounded lease over pending events.
type OutboxClaim struct {
	WorkerID    string
	Limit       int
	Now         time.Time
	LockedUntil time.Time
}

// Outbox exposes the durable relay state without leaking PostgreSQL into use cases.
type Outbox interface {
	Claim(ctx context.Context, claim OutboxClaim) ([]domain.IntegrationEvent, error)
	MarkPublished(ctx context.Context, eventID, workerID string, publishedAt time.Time) error
	MarkFailed(ctx context.Context, eventID, workerID, message string, retryAt time.Time) error
}
